papers.title: Conditioned medium fractionation identifies a soluble ligand that restores post-engulfment lysosome maturation
papers.abstract: Conditioned medium from resolving macrophages was separated by size fractionation. A candidate ligand was identified and validated by blockade and add-back. The inhibitor phenotype was rescued by downstream activation, linking soluble signals to lysosome maturation and functional efferocytosis.

papers.title: PYGL expression correlates with macrophage inflammatory state
papers.abstract: We report a transcriptomic association between PYGL expression and a macrophage state in inflamed tissue. The study does not test glycogenolysis, phosphorylation, rescue, or post-engulfment function.
